Appraiser remarks
The front bumper cover is cracked across the center and the upper radiator support is bent, with the hood latch and
both headlamp assebmlies damaged. The crush pattern and paint transfer line up with the reported head-on contact,
and nothing I found suggests earlier damage to this vehicle. The proposed plan replaces the bumper cover, radiator
support, and lamp assemblies and repairs the hood latch area. The invoices show no repeated charges. Labor hours
run a little high for this scope, so I have asked the shop to justify the time on the radiator support and alignment
entries before final approval.
